research_question: Does any one of the five language dictionaries used by Nepal and Perono (2024) show excess raw exact consonant-cluster overlap with the frozen Linear A master list beyond matched chance expectations, before any manual semantic filtering?

scope.primary_unit: raw exact consonant-cluster matches before manual plausibility/meaning filtering

must_include: one immutable file identity per fixed language
evidence that New Format values correspond to the 2024 paper input rather than an alternate public-program configuration

upstream_reproduction_layer.purpose: First reproduce the deterministic raw exact-match layer without using JANUS corrective nulls.
upstream_reproduction_layer.dictionary_operation: remove listed vowels from each dictionary word
upstream_reproduction_layer.Linear_A_cluster_operation: use the paper-exact normalized consonantal field from the admitted master list; do not silently regenerate it from a different phonetic grid
upstream_reproduction_layer.match_operation: exact string equality of consonant clusters
required_raw_outputs: every exact pairwise match with language, dictionary row, dictionary raw word, normalized dictionary cluster, Linear A row, Linear A source, Linear A raw/provisional form, normalized Linear A cluster
unique dictionary cluster universe per language

frozen_primary_metrics.definition: number of distinct eligible Linear A consonant clusters having at least one exact match in a language dictionary
number of raw Linear A row x dictionary row exact consonant-cluster matches, preserving row multiplicity
number of distinct dictionary consonant clusters having at least one eligible Linear A exact match

N1_WITHIN_LANGUAGE_COMPOSITION_PRESERVIN.purpose: Estimate accidental exact matches while preserving each language dictionary's row count, normalized cluster-length sequence, and global consonant multiset.
algorithm: For each language independently, collect normalized non-empty dictionary consonants across rows.
Randomly permute that exact consonant multiset.
Redistribute consonants into the original ordered row-length sequence.
Keep the Linear A master list fixed.

N2_POOLED_LENGTH_STRATIFIED_LANGUAGE_LAB.purpose: Test whether a named language has more overlap than expected from an equally sized length-matched allocation of the pooled five-language dictionary clusters.
algorithm: Pool admitted normalized dictionary rows from all five fixed languages.
Within exact consonant-cluster-length strata, permute language labels while preserving each language's observed row count per stratum whenever combinatorially possible.
Keep cluster strings and Linear A fixed.
Recompute all frozen metrics for all five languages in the same permutation.

permutation_protocol.minimum_iterations_if_exact_enumeration_: enumerate all distinct permutations instead of sampling
permutation_protocol.deterministic_seed_rule: SHA256(artifact_uuid || null_id || zero_based_iteration) interpreted as an unsigned integer

familywise_control.method: permutation max-statistic across all five languages within each null family

decision_rule.NO_EXCESS: No language attains FWER-adjusted p <= 0.05 under both N1 and N2 for the primary metric.
decision_rule.TECHNICAL_OVERLAP_EXCESS_SIGNAL: A language attains FWER-adjusted p <= 0.05 under both N1 and N2 for UNIQUE_LINEAR_A_CLUSTER_HIT_COUNT and observed-minus-null-mean is positive under both nulls.
decision_rule.DISCORDANT_NULLS: A language clears only one null family; report the discordance without promotion.
